---
title: "Research"
---

My research focuses on international economic integration, financial transmission, applied econometrics, and environmental macroeconomics.

## Ongoing research

- [North American financial connectedness](projects/connectedness.qmd): time-varying connectedness across asset classes and investment horizons.
- [Dynamic Granger causality under the USMCA](projects/granger-usmca.qmd): exchange-rate returns and interest-rate differentials.
- [Temperature shocks and state-level activity](projects/temperature.qmd): heterogeneous local projection responses in Mexico.
- [Monetary policy transmission](projects/monetary-policy.qmd): identifying monetary innovations with macroeconomic information.

## Methods

Time-varying parameter vector autoregressions, frequency-domain connectedness, dynamic Granger causality, autoregressive distributed lag models, and panel local projections.
